verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented feature for choosing where LiveKit Cloud stores data (no region or residency selection). Nearby items do not count. Region-restricted SIP trunks are about telephony regulation, not data storage. PrivateLink connects agents to a VPC. Self-hosting is a deployment option rather than a residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
